sentences.l2: 很多国家现在不让用塑料袋。
sentences.l1: Many countries now do not allow plastic bags to be used.
This is to protect the environment.

sentences.l2: 有些国家说，商店不能给顾客免费塑料袋。
sentences.l1: Some countries say that shops cannot give customers free plastic bags.

sentences.l2: 顾客要付钱才能拿到袋子。
sentences.l1: Customers have to pay money to get a bag.

sentences.l2: 这样做是为了让顾客少用塑料袋。
sentences.l1: This is done so that customers use fewer plastic bags.

sentences.l2: 政府会检查商店有没有遵守规定。
sentences.l1: The government will check whether shops are following the rules.
This is called legislation and regulation.

sentences.l2: 世界很多地方都在这样做。
sentences.l1: Many places in the world are doing this.

sentences.l2: 因为塑料不好，用完后会变成垃圾。
sentences.l1: Because plastic is bad, it becomes rubbish after it is used.

sentences.l2: 河流和大海里都有塑料垃圾。
sentences.l1: There is plastic rubbish in both rivers and seas.

sentences.l2: 动物会吃这些垃圾，然后生病。
sentences.l1: Animals eat this rubbish and then get sick.

sentences.l2: 人们希望以后用纸袋或布袋。
sentences.l1: People hope to use paper bags or cloth bags in future.

sentences.l2: 这些袋子可以用很多次。
sentences.l1: These bags can be used many times.
This is better for the Earth.
